styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a pale grey-green rectangular panel with a thin frame and a faint mesh. It has only 5 distinct colours in total, so it has about 2 lightness steps, against 5-6 on the references (hedge, well roof, stall awning). The measured facts show 0 visible tones per tile because the piece is thin and sparse, so I judged density by eye. Against the hedge, well and stall it looks much thinner, flatter and more sticker-like. It also does not read as a roof fence, with no roof tiles or wood. A careful artist would not accept it next to the references.
